params.body:
- stocklist:fotos-afgeleid: --shard=i/n now also applies to the plain backfill (rows without media_version), not only to --maat. Production has ~124,000 photos to do on Tuesday.
- CUTOVER.md: run the backfill in four shards right after the import; everything staging wrote in the bucket sits under vehicles/demo/ (the seal) and is orphaned once the fresh dump is in and APP_ENV=production: rclone size, then rclone purge, listed under step 6.
params.title: Backfill shards for the plain run; cutover notes on demo/ and shards
